findings.message: not measured: conformance/src/new.mjs could not be read, so a tooling file in it cannot be seen
findings.fix: Make the file readable (permissions) and run the check again.

findings.message: new non-Rust tooling file `scripts/new.sh`: tooling is written in Rust and run through `./dev` (ADR 0022 §3.7)
findings.fix: Write it in Rust as a `./dev` command (ADR 0022: tooling is Rust; tools/paddock-dev). A file that must stay shell or JavaScript (it runs before `./dev` exists, or the tool it drives is JavaScript) needs an entry in conformance/tooling-files.json, which the user approves.
